lines.text: JESSIE: We came all the way to Lavender Town\non the boss’s orders, but...
Where in the world is this old man Fuji supposed\nto be?
JAMES: The only place left is that spooky old\nPokémon Tower, right?
JESSIE: That’s right... [VAR COLOR(0006)]We couldn’t get to the top[VAR COLOR(0000)]\nbecause of that [VAR COLOR(0006)]strange ghost[VAR COLOR(0000)] getting in the way.

JAMES: Well, we couldn’t find that old man, but
at least we found this Cubone!\c
Let’s get it back to our hideout. At least we’ll
have something to show for our trouble.
JESSIE: Right! Let’s head to the [VAR COLOR(0006)]Rocket[VAR COLOR(0000)]\n[VAR COLOR(0006)]Game Corner[VAR COLOR(0000)] in [VAR COLOR(0006)]Celadon City[VAR COLOR(0000)]!
CUBONE: Maaa?
JESSIE: Aww, does the wittle Cubone want its\nmommy? Your mommy’s in Celadon City.\c\nCome with us. We’ll take you there.
CUBONE: Maa! Maa!
Now that that’s decided, I think we’d better\nblast off!
I-I just saw something awful...
Hey, did you see?!\nTeam Rocket abducted that poor Cubone!
It sounded like they were headed to\n[VAR COLOR(0006)]Celadon City[VAR COLOR(0000)], but...
They must be planning on taking the skull bone\nit wears and selling it at a high price!
You rescued that Cubone from Team Rocket?!\nWow, that’s pretty amazing!
Take these, as a thank-you!
You got 20 Great Balls!
I bet someone brave like you could go up\nthe Pokémon Tower, no problem!
JESSIE: There! Come on! Almost got it...\nAaah, so close!
JAMES: C’mon, Jessie, why don’t we head to\nthe hideout now?

JESSIE: Oh come on, we’ve already handed over
the [VAR COLOR(0006)]Cubone[VAR COLOR(0000)] to another Team Rocket member.
What’s the harm in taking a little break?\c
How were we supposed to open the [VAR COLOR(0006)]hidden[VAR COLOR(0000)]
[VAR COLOR(0006)]entrance to the hideout[VAR COLOR(0000)], anyway?

JAMES: We just need to check the [VAR COLOR(0006)]poster[VAR COLOR(0000)] with
a [VAR COLOR(0006)]vehicle on it[VAR COLOR(0000)], remember?\c
It’s a poster with a [VAR COLOR(0006)]vehicle[VAR COLOR(0000)] that’s the best way to
[VAR COLOR(0006)]represent us[VAR COLOR(0000)]!
JESSIE: What do you mean? What kind of\nvehicle is the best way to represent us?
JAMES: You know, those things that [VAR COLOR(0006)]blast off[VAR COLOR(0000)]\n[VAR COLOR(0006)]into space[VAR COLOR(0000)]?
MEOWTH: Mrowr.
